title: "Inspector Sharma" digital arrest (live demo)
description: The stage storyline: FedEx parcel hook, CBI transfer, secrecy, arrest threat, RBI safe account.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mrs. Lakshmi? This is a call from FedEx international courier.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Madam, a parcel booked with your Aadhaar number was stopped at Mumbai customs. It contains five fake passports and 200 grams of MDMA drugs.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: What? I never sent any parcel.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I am transferring your call to the Mumbai cyber crime branch. Please hold.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Good afternoon madam, I am Inspector Vikram Sharma, CBI, my badge number is CBI4521. Your FIR number is MH/2026/0917.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Your name has come up in a money laundering case. This is a matter of national security, so do not tell anyone, not even your family.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Okay sir, I will not tell anyone.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Stay on the video call and do not disconnect. From this moment you are under digital arrest. An arrest warrant will be issued within two hours.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: To prove your innocence, transfer your savings to the RBI safe account for verification. It is fully refundable after the investigation. The UPI ID is rbi.safe@okaxis.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Also install AnyDesk so our technical team can check your bank account.
